name: SVG Doodles
description: A browsable set of hand-drawn style doodles (circles, arrows, blobs, highlights) you can recolor and resize in the browser and copy the SVG straight out, no download or account needed. Good for adding an informal, sketched accent to an otherwise clean layout.

best.title: SVG Doodles
best.note: Browse, recolor and copy any doodle directly in the browser.
